global_rule: independent per-property judgments; not a universal life score

criteria.positive_evidence: Recurrent spatial-temporal structure under a pinned update rule
criteria.critical_null: Static pattern, translated glider and periodic oscillator
criteria.falsifier: Recurrence attributable to one unbranching causal trajectory

criteria.positive_evidence: Two sibling descendants depend on parent through necessary causal edges and not on one another
criteria.critical_null: Glider gun emits other structure; glider repeats; shared environmental source generates twins without causal parent
criteria.falsifier: Daughters cannot be causally separated or are produced by engine cloning

criteria.positive_evidence: Grandchildren that satisfy independent sibling and causal ancestry tests across time
criteria.critical_null: Single generation c0-style copying; repeated emission without daughter reproduction
criteria.falsifier: Only founder produces copies while all daughter lines terminate

criteria.positive_evidence: Offspring acquire distinct variant function from identifiable parent organization and pass it onward under a novel assay
criteria.critical_null: Environment-only induced resemblance, shuffled parent links, identical-copy-only patterns
criteria.falsifier: New variation is phenotypic noise or disappears under parent-shuffle/independent-function test

criteria.positive_evidence: Internal causal repair loop restores a persistent organization after damage with quantified component turnover
criteria.critical_null: Engine-respawn, protected cell memory, passive attractor, external healing script
criteria.falsifier: Recovery remains unchanged when internally identified repair route is ablated

criteria.positive_evidence: Internally regulated resource uptake and output causally change lifetime and recovery
criteria.critical_null: Unlimited replenishment, cosmetic energy meter, immortal update rule
criteria.falsifier: Resource perturbation has no predicted causal effect on organization or ledger does not balance

criteria.positive_evidence: Behavior changes adaptively when previously unseen viability-threatening conditions change, with confirmed survival effect
criteria.critical_null: Same reflex in every state; hidden designer fitness reward; cue scramble
criteria.falsifier: Fitness gain disappears after changing the cues or predicted viability conditions

criteria.positive_evidence: Repeated independent new functional capabilities inherited by distinct lineages in several future environmental conditions
criteria.critical_null: Externally rewarded visual novelty, raw pattern entropy, mass-only activity, neutral shadow, repeated fixed task bonus
criteria.falsifier: New functions plateau or are no different from null after removing external novelty objective

criteria.positive_evidence: Causally inherited interpreter/rule-semantic change creates a viable new functional behavior unavailable under fixed language
criteria.critical_null: Renamed syntax, random opcode corruption, human-chosen language upgrade, increased compute or extra action types
criteria.falsifier: Only representation changes, behavior fails transfer, or no progeny inherit semantic capacity

criteria.positive_evidence: Causally cohesive but spatially separated components jointly sustain replication with intervention-supported dependencies
criteria.critical_null: Connected component label only, independent oscillators, random spatial co-occurrence
criteria.falsifier: Apparent group survives arbitrary removal of components or causal graph only links via environment-level common cause
